included.goal: Mandate 73 recursion adapter, first slice: a component can be a driver and an engine at once, nested through capability dispatch, with preserved identity/provenance, no permission amplification, parent-reserved budgets, inherited deadlines, depth and fan-out bounds, cycle refusal, cancellation propagation and failure propagation; continue the nesting across the socket with an envelope on os_capabilities and the CLI.
included.title: Recursive driver/engine delegation contract on the core capability bus

included.goal: Owed from T-NOFAKES-1: core sending the chosen model to the local engine. Core already sent selected_model (the id) on gpu_fabric.local_engine.infer_stream, but the commercial plug resolves ids differently (exact file name in its own data dir, no .gguf stem match, no SUSI_MODEL_DIR), so a model core selected and loaded could be 'not found' in the plug. The builtin plug now also sends model_path, the file core's ModelManager resolved for selected_model (additive; older plugs ignore it). The unreachable duplicate bus call in SusiGgufEngine is removed (local_engine_plug() is Some whenever that topic is wired), so susi-gemi shrinks. Commercial counterpart: susi-commercial-apps T-MODELPICK-1.
included.title: Local inference: the plug call carries the weights core resolved for the selected model

included.goal: When failover exhausted cloud and local inference, cloud_recovery wrote '<data>/delegations/{antigravity,codex}_request_<ts>.md' and reported 'Recovery is pending with external agents: antigravity, codex'. No process in core or commercial reads that directory, so the claim described work nobody was doing. Remove the inbox write; antigravity and codex go through the same plane-bus external_run as the other fallback agents.
included.title: Cloud recovery never reports an unread inbox file as a delegation

included.goal: Make the recursion adapter's cross-process envelope unforgeable: only a DelegationAuthority keyed from the host's shared MAC key issues or admits susi-delegation/v1 envelopes (HMAC-SHA256, random id, absolute expiry <= 1 h); tampered, unsigned, expired or foreign-host envelopes are refused; replays in one process continue one level (shared budget and fan-out); revocation cancels a level and its descendants; os_capabilities and the CLI gain a delegate action that issues envelopes under the same bounds.
included.title: Host-signed delegation envelopes: issue, admit, replay ledger and revocation
